# HSAUR3 `bladdercancer` (plain NB2 Poisson-limit repro)

Committed `bladder.csv` is the 31-row recurrence-count subset from the **HSAUR3**
package (`bladdercancer` data frame: `number`, `tumorsize`, `time`). Source:
CRAN package HSAUR3 (MIT/GPL data; no drmTMB GPL source vendored here).

Used by `test/test_issue_1072_poisson_limit_fe.jl` (refs #1072).
